company.shortDescription: Cairns Health is a digital care companion for senior living and home care, integrating ambient sensing, AI, and LLMs to empower patients.
company.description: Cairns Health is a digital care companion and enablement platform for senior living and home care. The company's digital care plan enablement solution integrates intelligent ambient sensing (radar), artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLM's) to streamline caregiver-patient interactions, boost engagement, and empower patients with a better understanding of their care plans, leading to timely interventions that improve care while reducing overall care delivery costs.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,200,000, or 97.74% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,089,550 to $19,921,318, a 6.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 31 (-10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
